notes: the first «ح» splits two routes; both meet at the second «شعبة», and «عن الحكم، عن مجاهد، عن ابن عباس» is written once after that: the shared tail (rule 3)
«وابن، بشار» is a co-transmitter with the comma kept as written; «- واللفظ له -» is a gloss: left out
«حدثنا أبي» is the father of عبيد الله: relation link; the Prophet is the end, Ibn Abbas the Companion
